description: Land Acquisition - Pallemaluwa, Hanguranketha D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
